title: Question 27
passage:
Should I tighten these hinges before or after I line up the two panels?
A. The panels came in the same box. B. Get the panels straight first. C. That screwdriver is on the bench.
passageZh:
我該先把兩片面板對齊再鎖緊鉸鏈，還是先鎖緊？
A. 兩片面板裝在同一個箱子裡送來。 B. 先把兩片面板對齊。 C. 那支螺絲起子在工作台上。
